name: tripo-wall-09
prompt: A section of a steep mountain valley wall, a near-vertical face of grey granite about 40 metres wide and 30 metres high, natural irregular silhouette, big blocky joints, slanted ledges with loose rock, dark streaks of water, a fan of fallen boulders at the foot. Realistic photogrammetry scan, no plants.

name: tripo-wall-10
prompt: A wide low cliff band of weathered grey rock about 45 metres wide and 12 metres high, fractured into columns and blocks, undercut base with a talus slope of broken rock, irregular natural top edge. Realistic photogrammetry scan, no plants.

name: tripo-wall-11
prompt: A tall sheer rock face of dark grey gneiss with diagonal foliation bands, about 30 metres wide and 40 metres high, sharp angular overhangs, one deep vertical gully, rubble at the foot. Realistic photogrammetry scan, no plants.

name: tripo-boulder-06
prompt: A long low slab of grey granite about 6 metres long lying on the ground, one end lifted, cracked surface with lichen and a little moss. Realistic photogrammetry scan, flat underside.

name: tripo-gravel-01
prompt: A river gravel bar, a low flat bank of rounded grey and brown river stones and pebbles about 15 metres long and 1 metre high, a few larger cobbles, some driftwood. Realistic photogrammetry scan.

name: tripo-riverrock-01
prompt: A cluster of large rounded water-worn boulders in a mountain river, dark wet grey granite with pale tide lines, about 6 metres across. Realistic photogrammetry scan, flat base.

name: tripo-spire-02
prompt: An ancient slender tower of dark weathered stone about 44 metres tall, square base with buttresses, round shaft wrapped by three bronze rings, at the top an open bronze cage of curved claws holding a large glowing pale blue crystal orb. Moss on the base. Realistic, game asset.

name: tripo-hoard-03
prompt: A dragon's hoard heaped in a shallow rocky hollow: a wide low mound of gold coins about 14 metres across, gold plates, goblets, crowns and gemstones, a cracked chest, a broken spear, scorched rock around the edge. Realistic, detailed, game asset.

name: tripo-wardstone-02
prompt: An ancient ward relic: a tight cluster of seven tall jagged black basalt shards about 15 metres tall, carved with glowing rune grooves, bound by two heavy studded iron bands, the shards leaning outward around an empty hollow centre, one long shard hanging below. Realistic, game asset.

name: tripo-watchtower-03
prompt: A weathered square stone watchtower about 38 metres tall on a rocky knoll, rough grey granite masonry, small windows, a wooden roofed lookout on top and a large iron fire brazier on a stone platform at the front of the top. Moss and lichen. Realistic, game asset.
